questions.explanation: 根据最后一段中的“making my daily concerns insignificant”可知，作者去划船是为了忘记日常的“担忧/烦恼”(concerns)。
questions.supplement:
A(concerns): 语境句：She forgot her daily concerns when she was on holiday. 固定搭配：daily concerns, public concerns
B(principles): 语境句：He refused to compromise his moral principles. 固定搭配：stick to principles, basic principles
C(passions): 语境句：He has a deep passion for literature. 固定搭配：have a passion for, follow your passion
D(secrets): 语境句：They shared their deepest secrets with each other. 固定搭配：keep a secret, top secret

questions.explanation: 空格处表示原因，正是因为作者和妻子“沉浸于(Absorbed in)”美丽的风景中，才几乎没有意识到危险的逼近。Tired of意为厌倦；Looking into意为调查；Reflecting on意为反思，均不符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(Tired of): 语境句：He grew tired of the repetitive daily routine. 固定搭配：be tired of, get tired of
B(Absorbed in): 语境句：Absorbed in the fascinating book, she didn't hear the knock. 固定搭配：be absorbed in, completely absorbed in
C(Looking into): 语境句：The police are looking into the cause of the fire. 固定搭配：look into a case, look into a matter
D(Reflecting on): 语境句：Reflecting on his past mistakes, he decided to change. 固定搭配：reflect on oneself, reflect on the past

questions.explanation: 结合冒号后的解释“a huge mama bear with two babies”可知，刚开始他们只是从树林中看到了三个巨大的“模糊轮廓/身影(shapes)”。
questions.supplement:
A(signs): 语境句：There are no obvious signs of improvement in the economy. 固定搭配：signs of life, warning signs
B(pictures): 语境句：He took many beautiful pictures during his trip. 固定搭配：take pictures, draw a picture
C(targets): 语境句：The company has set high sales targets for this year. 固定搭配：achieve a target, set a target
D(shapes): 语境句：We could barely make out the shapes of buildings in the fog. 固定搭配：in the shape of, take shape

questions.explanation: 他们离熊不到100英尺，这远近于推荐的“安全(safe)”距离。
questions.supplement:
A(social): 语境句：She is very active in local social events. 固定搭配：social media, social skills
B(safe): 语境句：It is important to keep a safe distance from wild animals. 固定搭配：safe distance, safe and sound
C(average): 语境句：The average temperature here is quite high in summer. 固定搭配：on average, above average
D(constant): 语境句：The machine requires a constant supply of electricity. 固定搭配：constant change, constant companion

questions.explanation: 面对距离极近的熊，危险逼近，且后文提到“The experience, the fear...”，可知作者感到深深的“恐惧(fear)”。易错点是选surprise，但面对猛兽袭来的直觉反应应为恐惧。
questions.supplement:
A(fear): 语境句：She overcame her fear of the dark eventually. 固定搭配：in fear, out of fear
B(surprise): 语境句：To our surprise, he won the first prize in the competition. 固定搭配：in surprise, to one's surprise
C(excitement): 语境句：The children jumped up and down in excitement. 固定搭配：in excitement, cause excitement
D(courage): 语境句：It takes great courage to admit one's mistakes. 固定搭配：have the courage to do, lose courage

questions.explanation: 作者抓起喷雾，顺流而下，是为了拉开自己和熊之间的“距离(distance)”。distance作动词，意为“疏远，与...拉开距离”。
questions.supplement:
A(relax): 语境句：Listening to soft music helps me relax after work. 固定搭配：relax oneself, relax the rules
B(corner): 语境句：The thief was finally cornered by the police in an alley. 固定搭配：around the corner, drive into a corner
C(dismiss): 语境句：The manager dismissed the idea as impractical. 固定搭配：dismiss a meeting, dismiss an idea
D(distance): 语境句：He tried to distance himself from the scandal. 固定搭配：distance oneself from, keep a distance

questions.explanation: 作者对熊喊话以示安抚：“我们不是来‘打扰(bother)’你们的”。tease意为取笑，不合猛兽语境。
questions.supplement:
A(bathe): 语境句：The doctor advised him to bathe the wound with warm water. 固定搭配：bathe in sunlight, take a bath
B(tease): 语境句：The boys used to tease him about his strange accent. 固定搭配：tease someone about, playfully tease
C(bother): 语境句：Please don't bother your father while he is working. 固定搭配：bother to do, bother someone with
D(pet): 语境句：She bent down to pet the cute little dog. 固定搭配：pet a dog, pet animals

questions.explanation: 由后半句“covering the 100 feet in seconds”可知，作者当时以为母熊会以极快的速度越过河“猛冲/冲锋(charge)”过来。charge在此指猛兽的突击冲锋。
questions.supplement:
A(sail): 语境句：The ship will sail for New York next week. 固定搭配：sail across, set sail
B(float): 语境句：The empty bottle floated on the surface of the water. 固定搭配：float away, float on water
C(charge): 语境句：The angry bull lowered its head and charged at the man. 固定搭配：charge at, in charge of
D(wander): 语境句：We spent the afternoon wandering around the old town. 固定搭配：wander around, wander aimlessly

questions.explanation: 因为母熊几秒钟就能跑完100英尺，所以作者认为即使会用喷雾，也没有时间“及时(in time)”使用它。
questions.supplement:
A(in advance): 语境句：You need to book the tickets in advance during holidays. 固定搭配：book in advance, pay in advance
B(at random): 语境句：The teacher chose a student at random to answer the question. 固定搭配：choose at random, pick at random
C(at peace): 语境句：After resolving the conflict, she finally felt at peace. 固定搭配：feel at peace, live at peace
D(in time): 语境句：Luckily, the firefighters arrived in time to put out the fire. 固定搭配：in time, just in time

questions.explanation: 令作者惊讶的是，母熊并没有发起攻击，而“仅仅是(simply)”在河里喝水。
questions.supplement:
A(probably): 语境句：He will probably be late because of the heavy traffic. 固定搭配：very probably, most probably
B(simply): 语境句：The solution to the problem is simply to communicate more. 固定搭配：simply put, simply ignore
C(naturally): 语境句：She is naturally talented in playing the piano. 固定搭配：act naturally, naturally gifted
D(certainly): 语境句：I will certainly attend your birthday party tonight. 固定搭配：almost certainly, certainly not

questions.explanation: 当一只小熊走远了几步，母熊很快把它“接回/找回(fetched)”。fetch意为“去取来，接回”。rescue(救援)程度太重，小熊仅仅是走远了几步。
questions.supplement:
A(rescued): 语境句：The firefighters rescued the child from the burning building. 固定搭配：rescue someone from, come to one's rescue
B(abandoned): 语境句：The broken car was abandoned by the side of the road. 固定搭配：abandon a plan, permanently abandoned
C(fetched): 语境句：The dog ran to fetch the stick thrown by its owner. 固定搭配：fetch water, fetch someone
D(examined): 语境句：The doctor examined the patient carefully. 固定搭配：examine closely, physically examine

questions.explanation: 熊的离开就像它们“出乎意料的(unexpected)”出现一样快。文中熊是突然从森林里出现的，完全出乎作者的意料。
questions.supplement:
A(timely): 语境句：The government provided timely assistance to the earthquake victims. 固定搭配：timely manner, timely help
B(inappropriate): 语境句：His casual clothes were inappropriate for such a formal occasion. 固定搭配：highly inappropriate, inappropriate behavior
C(unexpected): 语境句：The project was delayed due to an unexpected problem. 固定搭配：unexpected result, completely unexpected
D(regular): 语境句：Regular exercise is essential for maintaining good health. 固定搭配：on a regular basis, regular check-up

questions.explanation: 经历了自然和猛兽的震撼后，作者陷入了对大自然的“敬畏(awe)”之中。从最后一段中作者感到自身渺小并改变了世界观可知，不仅仅是震惊(shock)，更是一种敬畏之心。
questions.supplement:
A(awe): 语境句：The tourists stood in awe of the magnificent waterfall. 固定搭配：in awe of, an awe-inspiring sight
B(shock): 语境句：The news of his sudden resignation came as a shock to everyone. 固定搭配：in shock, a culture shock
C(regret): 语境句：To my great regret, I missed the opportunity to study abroad. 固定搭配：express regret, much to one's regret
D(calmness): 语境句：He handled the emergency with surprising calmness. 固定搭配：maintain calmness, inner calmness

questions.explanation: 这次偶遇让作者感到自身的渺小(humbled)。humble作动词表示“使感到谦卑、使感到自己微不足道”，与后文的“making my daily concerns insignificant”一致。
questions.supplement:
A(astonished): 语境句：We were astonished at the rapid progress he had made. 固定搭配：be astonished at, absolutely astonished
B(humbled): 语境句：The famous scientist was humbled by the vastness of the universe. 固定搭配：feel humbled, a humbling experience
C(refreshed): 语境句：After a good night's sleep, I woke up feeling completely refreshed. 固定搭配：feel refreshed, totally refreshed
D(fueled): 语境句：His success fueled her determination to work even harder. 固定搭配：fuel the fire, heavily fueled

questions.explanation: 在广阔的大自然面前，作者意识到了作为人类的“局限性(limitations)”，这彻底改变了他的世界观。
questions.supplement:
A(limitations): 语境句：We must recognize our own limitations and seek help when needed. 固定搭配：know one's limitations, overcome limitations
B(responsibilities): 语境句：Parents have many responsibilities towards their children. 固定搭配：take responsibilities, shoulder responsibilities
C(advantages): 语境句：Living in a big city has its own advantages and disadvantages. 固定搭配：take advantage of, an unfair advantage
D(virtues): 语境句：Patience and kindness are considered important virtues in many cultures. 固定搭配：a man of virtue, moral virtues

vocab_pack.definition_en: to travel or spend time in a boat for pleasure
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中为一般过去时 went boating，go 的过去式 went，boating 为动名词作宾语，构成固定短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: We plan to go boating on the lake this weekend.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们计划这个周末去湖上划船。
vocab_pack.from_passage: went boating on the Blackfoot River

vocab_pack.definition_en: feeling or showing happiness and enthusiasm about something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 be excited about 为系表结构，was 是一般过去时，excited 是形容词，about 引出兴奋的对象。
vocab_pack.example_en: The students are excited about the upcoming field trip.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 学生们对即将到来的实地考察感到兴奋。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I was excited about the trip

vocab_pack.definition_en: to permit someone to do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 allow 是动词原形（前有 would），后接宾语 me 和带 to 的不定式短语 to forget，表示允许我忘记。
vocab_pack.example_en: The teacher allowed us to leave early.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 老师允许我们早点离开。
vocab_pack.from_passage: it would allow me to forget my concerns

vocab_pack.definition_en: fully engaged or engrossed in something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 Absorbed in 为过去分词短语作状语，表被动含义，逻辑主语是 we，表示“我们被美景吸引”。
vocab_pack.example_en: She was completely absorbed in reading the novel.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她完全沉浸于那部小说中。

vocab_pack.definition_en: almost not; only just
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 barely 修饰动词 realized，表示“几乎没有意识到”，位于实义动词之前。
vocab_pack.example_en: He barely escaped the accident.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他勉强逃过了事故。
vocab_pack.from_passage: we barely realized the approaching danger

vocab_pack.definition_en: to come near or nearer to something in space or time
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 approaching 为现在分词作前置定语，修饰 danger，表示“正在靠近的危险”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Winter is approaching, so we need warm clothes.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 冬天临近了，我们需要保暖衣物。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to come out of a place or appear from something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 emerged 为一般过去时，与 from 构成短语动词，主语 three large shapes。
vocab_pack.example_en: The sun emerged from behind the clouds.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 太阳从云层后面出现了。
vocab_pack.from_passage: three large shapes emerged from the forest

vocab_pack.definition_en: an unpleasant emotion caused by the threat of danger, pain, or harm
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 fear 为名词，作动词 feel 的宾语，后接定语从句或宾语从句（此处结构略特殊）。
vocab_pack.example_en: She trembled with fear when she heard the noise.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她听到声音时吓得发抖。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I could feel fear reached deep into my stomach

vocab_pack.definition_en: to stop moving; remain motionless
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 stood 是 stand 的过去式，still 为副词，主语 Time，表示“时间静止了”。
vocab_pack.example_en: When the teacher walked in, everyone stood still.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 老师走进来时，所有人都站着不动。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to take hold of something quickly and firmly
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 grabbed 是动词原形 grab 的过去式，与主语 I 一致，表示迅速抓取的动作。
vocab_pack.example_en: He grabbed the rope to save himself.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他抓住绳子救了自己。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to move or stay away from something or someone, especially to avoid involvement
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 使自己远离；使自己疏远
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 to distance 为不定式短语作目的状语，distance 是动词，ourselves 为反身代词，表示“让自己远离”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The politician tried to distance himself from the scandal.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那位政客试图使自己远离丑闻。
vocab_pack.from_passage: we walked downriver to distance ourselves

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause trouble or annoyance to someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 bother 为动词原形，用于否定句“not here to bother you”，后接宾语 you。
vocab_pack.example_en: Sorry to bother you, but could you help me?
vocab_pack.example_zh: 抱歉打扰你，你能帮我吗？
vocab_pack.from_passage: We are not here to bother you.

vocab_pack.definition_en: to rush or move quickly and aggressively across a place
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 charge 为动词原形（虚拟语气），across 为介词，表示“冲过河流”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The soldiers charged across the field under fire.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 士兵们在炮火下冲过田野。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the mama bear would charge across the river

vocab_pack.definition_en: within a very short period of time (a few seconds)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 in seconds 为介词短语作程度状语，修饰动作 covering，表示“在几秒内”。
vocab_pack.example_en: The fire spread in seconds.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 火势在几秒钟内蔓延开来。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to employ or operate a spray (e.g., bear spray) for a specific purpose
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 use 为动词原形（could use 情态动词后），后接名词短语 the spray 作宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: You should learn how to use the spray before hiking.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 徒步前你应该学会如何使用喷雾。
vocab_pack.from_passage: I didn't think I could use it in time

vocab_pack.definition_en: in a way that causes someone to feel surprised
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 To our surprise 为固定短语置于句首，our 根据主语替换，表示“令我们惊讶的是”。
vocab_pack.example_en: To his surprise, the exam was easier than expected.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 令他惊讶的是，考试比预期的简单。
vocab_pack.from_passage: To our surprise, the mama bear simply drank water

vocab_pack.definition_en: in a straightforward or uncomplicated way; just
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 simply 修饰动词 drank，表示“只是喝水”，强调动作简单。
vocab_pack.example_en: He simply forgot the meeting.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他只是忘记了会议。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the mama bear simply drank water from the river

vocab_pack.definition_en: to walk slowly and aimlessly around a place
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 wandered 是一般过去时，表示小熊无目的地走开几步。
vocab_pack.example_en: She wandered along the beach collecting shells.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她沿着海滩漫步，捡贝壳。
vocab_pack.from_passage: When one baby wandered just a few steps away

vocab_pack.definition_en: to go after and bring back something or someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 fetched 为一般过去时，宾语 him（小熊），表示母熊迅速把小熊叫回。
vocab_pack.example_en: Can you fetch me a glass of water?
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你能给我拿杯水吗？

vocab_pack.definition_en: not expected; surprising
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 unexpected 为形容词，修饰名词 appearance，表示“意外的出现”。
vocab_pack.example_en: His sudden resignation was completely unexpected.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他突然辞职完全出乎意料。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to become invisible by going into something (e.g., a place)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 disappearing 为现在分词，与助动词 were 构成过去进行时（were disappearing），表示正消失进森林。
vocab_pack.example_en: The thief disappeared into the crowd.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 小偷消失在人群中。
vocab_pack.from_passage: they were gone, disappearing into the forest

vocab_pack.definition_en: to go back to a place or situation
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 returned 是一般过去时，to 为介词，后接名词 our boat 表示回到船上。
vocab_pack.example_en: After the break, we returned to our seats.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 休息后我们回到了座位上。

vocab_pack.definition_en: completely absorbed or affected by a feeling of awe
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 lost 为过去分词作表语（或状语），in awe 为介词短语，表示我们因敬畏而失神。
vocab_pack.example_en: Standing before the ancient temple, we were lost in awe.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 站在古庙前，我们沉浸在敬畏之中。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make someone feel less important or proud; to cause humility
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 humbled 是一般过去时，及物动词，宾语 me，表示这次遭遇使我谦卑。
vocab_pack.example_en: The experience humbled him and changed his attitude.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 那次经历使他谦卑，改变了他的态度。

vocab_pack.definition_en: the ordinary worries or issues of everyday life
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 daily concerns 为名词短语，作动词 make 的宾语补足语的一部分（make my daily concerns insignificant）。
vocab_pack.example_en: He tried to put aside his daily concerns and relax.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他试图抛开日常琐事，放松一下。

vocab_pack.definition_en: too small or unimportant to be worth considering
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 insignificant 为形容词，作宾语补足语，修饰 my daily concerns，表示使它们显得不重要。
vocab_pack.example_en: The difference in cost is insignificant.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 成本上的差异微不足道。

vocab_pack.definition_en: in the circumstances or situation that surround something; considering something as part of a broader picture
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 在……的背景下；在……的大环境中
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 in the larger context of 为介词短语，后接 our planet，表示“在我们星球的大背景下”。
vocab_pack.example_en: We must view this problem in the context of global warming.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们必须在全球变暖的背景下看待这个问题。
vocab_pack.from_passage: in the larger context of our planet

vocab_pack.definition_en: a particular attitude or way of thinking about something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 perspective 为名词，on 引出看待的对象 the world，表示“对世界的看法”。
vocab_pack.example_en: Traveling changed my perspective on different cultures.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 旅行改变了我对不同文化的看法。
vocab_pack.from_passage: changed my perspective on the world

vocab_pack.definition_en: an unexpected or unplanned meeting with someone or something, often of a significant nature
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 偶遇；邂逅（常指重要的相遇）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 encounter 为名词，作主语，被 This 修饰，指代与熊的这次相遇。
vocab_pack.example_en: My encounter with a snake in the woods was frightening.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我在树林里与一条蛇的偶遇很吓人。

vocab_pack.definition_en: the feeling of being afraid or worried
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 fear 为名词，在列举中作为经历的一部分（The experience, the fear...）。
vocab_pack.example_en: Her fear of heights prevented her from climbing.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她的恐高症阻止了她攀爬。
vocab_pack.from_passage: The experience, the fear, and my limitations

vocab_pack.definition_en: a restriction or weakness; the quality of being limited
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中 limitations 为名词复数，my limitations as a human 表示“作为人类的局限性”。
vocab_pack.example_en: We must recognize our own limitations.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们必须认识到自己的局限性。

section_2_word_form.passage:
In the digital age, many young people tend to share marriage announcements on social media platforms like Sina Weibo. Yet a new trend has reemerged — publishing marriage announcements in traditional newspapers. [56] quick search on the topic “publishing marriage announcements in newspapers” will bring up [57] (variety) posts, along with those who have done so sharing their experiences.
[58] short-lived digital posts, newspaper announcements provide a sense of permanence, offering a meaningful way [59] (keep) memories during a time when digital content can't last. Some young people view publishing marriage announcements in newspapers as more formal than [60] in social media, and they describe it as a [61] (commit) written in black ink and on white paper — a declaration of the couple's promise to grow old together.
However, this practice is not a new phenomenon in China. In the first half of the twentieth century, when marriage laws were still underdeveloped, such announcements [62] (carry) legal significance. They allowed couples to [63] (public) share their joyous news with their family and friends.
The regained popularity serves as an example of [64] tradition can better adapt to modern times. By combining cultural heritage with personal creativity, it offers meaningful rituals (仪式) in today's digital world. These announcements, as symbols of love and individuality, remind us that some traditions are worth [65] (preserve).

questions.explanation: 句意：在相关话题上进行一次快速搜索…… a quick search 表示“一次快速搜索”，考查不定冠词泛指。首字母需大写。
questions.supplement: 正确形(A)：语境句：A quick search on the internet will give you the answer. 固定搭配：a quick search, a wide variety of。原词无其它变形。

questions.explanation: 空处修饰名词 posts，应使用形容词形式，variety 的形容词为 various，意为“各种各样的”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(various)：语境句：The school offers various activities for students after class. 固定搭配：various kinds of, for various reasons。原词variety其它变形：varied(adj.), vary(v.), variable(adj.)。

questions.explanation: 句意：与短暂的数字帖子不同，报纸声明提供了一种永久感。根据句意对比关系可知填介词 Unlike (与……不同)，位于句首需大写。
questions.supplement: 正确形(Unlike)：语境句：Unlike his brother, he is very shy and quiet. 固定搭配：quite unlike, entirely unlike。原词其它变形：like(prep./v.), likely(adj.), dislike(v.)。

questions.explanation: a way to do sth 为固定句型，表示“做某事的一种方式”，这里需用动词不定式作后置定语，修饰 way。
questions.supplement: 正确形(to keep)：语境句：Reading is a good way to keep your mind active. 固定搭配：a way to do sth, keep in mind。原词keep其它变形：kept(过去式/过去分词), keeper(n.), keeping(n.)。

questions.explanation: 此处比较的是“在报纸上发布结婚声明”和“在社交媒体上发布”，为了避免重复，用代词 that 替代单数/不可数概念的 publishing marriage announcements (即发声明这件事)。
questions.supplement: 正确形(that)：语境句：The weather in Beijing is colder than that in Shanghai. 固定搭配：that is to say, in that。原词其它变形：those(pl.)。

questions.explanation: 空前有不定冠词 a 修饰，此处应填入名词 commitment，意为“承诺”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(commitment)：语境句：Marriage is a lifelong commitment between two people. 固定搭配：make a commitment, a firm commitment。原词commit其它变形：committed(adj.), committee(n.)。

questions.explanation: 句中的时间状语 In the first half of the twentieth century 表明描述的是过去发生的事情，谓语动词需用一般过去时 carried，意为“具有（法律意义）”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(carried)：语境句：He carried the heavy box all the way to the top floor. 固定搭配：carry out, carry on。原词carry其它变形：carrying(现在分词), carrier(n.), carriage(n.)。

questions.explanation: 空处修饰动词 share，应使用副词形式 publicly，意为“公开地”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(publicly)：语境句：The company publicly apologized for the poor quality of its products. 固定搭配：publicly announce, publicly available。原词public其它变形：publication(n.), publicize(v.), publicity(n.)。

questions.explanation: 句意：这种重新兴起的流行趋势是传统“如何”更好地适应现代社会的一个例子。介词 of 后跟宾语从句，句意缺“如何”，用 how 引导。
questions.supplement: 正确形(how)：语境句：He explained to us how the new machine works. 固定搭配：how to do, no matter how。原词其它变形：however(adv.)。

questions.explanation: be worth doing 为固定搭配，意为“值得被做”，此处用动名词的主动形式表示被动意义，故填 preserving。
questions.supplement: 正确形(preserving)：语境句：These ancient historical sites are definitely worth preserving. 固定搭配：be worth preserving, preserve the environment。原词preserve其它变形：preservation(n.), preserved(adj.), preservative(n.)。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be likely to do something or usually do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语 many young people 是复数，所以动词 tend 用原形，后接不定式 to share
vocab_pack.example_en: Young people tend to share their experiences on social media.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 年轻人倾向于在社交媒体上分享他们的经历。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to appear again after a period of time
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在完成时，has 是助动词，reemerged 是过去分词，表示主语 a new trend 已经重新出现
vocab_pack.example_en: After the crisis, economic stability reemerged.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 危机之后，经济稳定重新出现。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make marriage announcements public, especially in newspapers
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动名词短语作主语的同位语，说明 new trend 的内容。publishing 是 publish 的动名词形式
vocab_pack.example_en: Many couples now choose to publish marriage announcements in local newspapers.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多夫妇现在选择在当地报纸上发布结婚启事。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a fast effort to find information
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定冠词 A + 形容词 quick + 名词 search，作句子主语，后接介词短语 on the topic
vocab_pack.example_en: A quick search on the internet will give you the answer.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 快速搜索一下互联网就能给你答案。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to mention a topic or produce something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般将来时，will bring up，动词 bring 用原形，后接宾语 various posts
vocab_pack.example_en: The discussion brought up many interesting points.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 讨论中提出了许多有趣的观点。

vocab_pack.definition_en: different from one another; of different kinds
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词修饰名词 posts，作定语
vocab_pack.example_en: There are various ways to solve this problem.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 解决这个问题有各种方法。

vocab_pack.definition_en: together with
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语，与前面内容连接，表示伴随关系，作状语
vocab_pack.example_en: She sent the letter along with a gift.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她把信连同礼物一起寄了出去。

vocab_pack.definition_en: lasting only a short time
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 复合形容词，修饰名词 digital posts，作定语
vocab_pack.example_en: The celebration was short-lived due to the rain.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 庆祝活动因为下雨而很短暂。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to give a feeling of
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语 newspaper announcements 是复数，所以 provide 用原形，后接 a sense of + 名词 permanence
vocab_pack.example_en: The new policy provides a sense of security.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 新政策提供了一种安全感。

vocab_pack.definition_en: the state or quality of lasting forever
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不可数名词，作介词 of 的宾语，与 a sense of 搭配
vocab_pack.example_en: The permanence of stone buildings is impressive.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 石头建筑的持久性令人印象深刻。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to present a valuable method to do something
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 提供一种有意义的方式去做
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词 offering 作伴随状语，与前面主句的 provide 并列；offering 后接宾语 a meaningful way to keep memories
vocab_pack.example_en: Volunteering offers a meaningful way to contribute to society.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 志愿服务提供了一种有意义的方式来为社会做贡献。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to preserve or retain memories
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式 to keep memories 作 way 的后置定语；keep 是及物动词，memories 是其宾语
vocab_pack.example_en: Photographs help us keep memories of our travels.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 照片帮助我们保留旅行中的记忆。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to say that someone or something has a particular quality
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语 they 复数，describe 用原形，后接宾语 it 和介词 as，引出补语 a commitment
vocab_pack.example_en: Many people describe it as a life-changing experience.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多人将其描述为一种改变人生的经历。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a promise or firm decision to do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 可数名词，用不定冠词 a 修饰，作 describe it as 的宾语补足语
vocab_pack.example_en: He made a commitment to finish the project.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他承诺完成这个项目。

vocab_pack.definition_en: written using ink (usually black)
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 用墨水书写（通常为黑色）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去分词短语作后置定语，修饰 commitment；write 的过去分词 written，后接介词短语 in black ink
vocab_pack.example_en: The contract must be written in ink, not pencil.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 合同必须用墨水书写，不能用铅笔。

vocab_pack.definition_en: a formal statement about something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，a declaration of 后接名词短语 the couple's promise，作表语或同位语
vocab_pack.example_en: The declaration of independence was signed in 1776.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 独立宣言于1776年签署。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to age together as a couple or group
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不定式短语 to grow old together 作 promise 的后置定语；grow 是系动词，old 是形容词表语，together 是副词
vocab_pack.example_en: They vowed to grow old together.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他们发誓要一起变老。

vocab_pack.definition_en: during the first part of a period
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语作时间状语，in 后接名词短语 the first half of the twentieth century，表示时间范围
vocab_pack.example_en: The event took place in the first half of the 20th century.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这一事件发生在20世纪上半叶。

vocab_pack.definition_en: not fully developed
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 形容词作表语，与 were still 构成系表结构，描述主语 marriage laws
vocab_pack.example_en: The region's economy remains underdeveloped.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该地区的经济仍然欠发达。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to have legal importance or meaning
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，carried 是 carry 的过去式，主语 such announcements 复数，后接宾语 legal significance
vocab_pack.example_en: A signature on this document carries legal significance.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 文件上的签名具有法律意义。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to permit someone to do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般过去时，allowed 是 allow 的过去式，后接间接宾语 couples 和带 to 的不定式短语 to publicly share；publicly 是副词修饰 share
vocab_pack.example_en: The teacher allowed the student to leave early.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 老师允许学生早点离开。

vocab_pack.definition_en: in a way that is done in public or openly
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 副词修饰动词 share，置于不定式 to 后，表示动作发生的方式
vocab_pack.example_en: The company publicly announced its new product.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该公司公开宣布了其新产品。

vocab_pack.definition_en: happy or joyful news
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 名词短语，joyous 是形容词作定语修饰 news，作 share 的宾语
vocab_pack.example_en: The joyous news of the baby's birth spread quickly.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 婴儿出生的喜讯迅速传开。

vocab_pack.definition_en: popularity that has been recovered
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 过去分词 regained 作定语修饰 popularity，表示被动和完成；popularity 为不可数名词
vocab_pack.example_en: The old song regained popularity after being used in a movie.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这首老歌在电影中被使用后重新流行起来。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to act as a model or illustration
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语 the regained popularity 第三人称单数，serves 是 serve 的第三人称单数形式，后接 as an example
vocab_pack.example_en: This case serves as an example of how to handle the situation.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个案例可以作为如何处理这种情况的例子。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to adjust to new conditions
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 助动词 can 后接动词原形 adapt，后接介词 to 和宾语 modern times
vocab_pack.example_en: Animals must adapt to changes in their environment.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 动物必须适应环境的变化。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to join together with something else
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 现在分词 combining 作介词 by 的宾语？实际是 by combining，combining 是动名词，后接宾语 cultural heritage 和介词 with，引出另一个被结合的元素 personal creativity
vocab_pack.example_en: Combine sugar with butter to make the dough.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 将糖与黄油混合制成面团。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to provide ceremonies or routines that have significance
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语 it 第三人称单数，offers 是 offer 的第三人称单数形式，后接宾语 meaningful rituals
vocab_pack.example_en: The festival offers meaningful rituals that strengthen community bonds.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个节日提供了加强社区纽带的有意义的仪式。

vocab_pack.definition_en: representing or standing for something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 介词短语 as + 名词 symbols + 介词 of，后接名词短语 love and individuality，作主语 These announcements 的补语
vocab_pack.example_en: The olive branch and the dove are symbols of peace.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 橄榄枝和鸽子是和平的象征。

vocab_pack.definition_en: the quality that makes someone or something different from others
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 不可数名词，与 love 并列作介词 of 的宾语
vocab_pack.example_en: She expressed her individuality through her art.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她通过艺术表达自己的个性。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause someone to remember something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 一般现在时，主语 These announcements 复数，谓语 remind 用原形，后接间接宾语 us 和 that 引导的宾语从句
vocab_pack.example_en: The teacher reminded the students that the exam was next week.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 老师提醒学生考试在下周。

vocab_pack.definition_en: to keep something in its original state or in good condition
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 动名词形式 preserving 在 worth 后作宾语，表示被动意义（值得被保存）
vocab_pack.example_en: We should preserve historical buildings for future generations.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们应该为后代保护历史建筑。
